import hashlib, json, re
from html.parser import HTMLParser
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.parse import urljoin, urlsplit

source = Path('products/services/catalogue-migration-agency-pilot/raw/shopify-partner-directory.html')
raw = source.read_bytes()
base = 'https://www.shopify.com/partners/directory'
class DirectoryLinks(HTMLParser):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.links = {}
    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
        if tag != 'a':
            return
        href = dict(attrs).get('href') or ''
        target = urlsplit(urljoin(base, href))
        if target.scheme != 'https' or target.netloc != 'www.shopify.com':
            return
        if re.search(r'/partners/directory/(partner/|locations/|services/)', target.path):
            url = 'https://www.shopify.com' + target.path
            self.links[url] = None

parser = DirectoryLinks()
parser.feed(raw.decode('utf-8'))
links = list(parser.links)
profiles = [url for url in links if '/directory/partner/' in url]
canada_or_migration = [url for url in links if re.search(r'canada|migration|product', url, re.I)]
result = {'source': base, 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(), 'unique_matching_links': len(links), 'profile_count': len(profiles), 'profile_pointers': profiles[:12], 'canada_or_migration_pointers': canada_or_migration[:12], 'scope': 'Static Shopify directory anchor links only. Confirm geography and catalogue migration scope from an agency source. Directory pointers do not establish an invitation to subcontract.'}
out = Path('products/services/catalogue-migration-agency-pilot/director-directory-pointers.json')
out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
out.write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
assert json.loads(out.read_text(encoding='utf-8')) == result
print(out.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
